changes.title: Repeated Waitlist signup returns the existing enrollment
changes.text: An unchanged signup can return the existing pending Waitlist enrollment instead of preparing a second purchase. The server checks the original Customer, ticket, quantity, subscriber and effective payment type; changed or duplicate enrollments are rejected. This is separate from fulfilling a Waitlist offer.
changes.limits: Requires the same unpurchased Waitlist basket and one pending subscriber. It is not permission to retry an uncertain paid order without checking its result.

qase.basis_or_limit: Saved cases cover existing fulfillment/expired-offer paths. They do not assert identical signup replay or changed-request rejection.
suggested_titles: Core - Waitlist - Repeat an unchanged signup without duplicating enrollment or payment

changes.title: Connecting a guest purchase retries one narrow ownership failure
changes.text: Order claiming retries a top-level deadlock specifically while assigning ticket ownership, up to three attempts. Each failed attempt rolls back before retry. Wrong-email access and later child/callback failures keep their existing rejection behavior.
changes.limits: Membership child orders, generated voucher ownership, delivery addresses and protection ownership share the claim operation. A normal browser run cannot prove the database retry or rollback paths.

qase.basis_or_limit: Saved cases cover same-email claim success and different-email rejection. They do not inject the narrow database deadlock, retries, child failure or rollback.
suggested_titles: Core - Guest Orders - Retry a ticket-ownership deadlock without duplicate or partial ownership

tests.title: Keep one normal Waitlist enrollment and one final order
tests.why: The retry guard runs before ordinary purchase preparation. A first signup and later fulfillment must still work without creating duplicate subscribers, orders or captured payments.
preparation: One approved test Event has an enabled Waitlist for 1 ticket. Record whether signup verifies a card or charges only on fulfillment.
Use one Customer test account. A setup owner supplies the normal fulfillment trigger and processing deadline; do not force production jobs.
steps: Open the Event’s normal purchase page, join its Waitlist for 1 ticket and submit once.
Refresh My Orders or the supported Waitlist confirmation and check that the same enrollment is shown.
When the prepared offer arrives, complete the supported purchase once and reopen the final order.
expectations: One pending enrollment exists before fulfillment. Its Customer, Event and quantity stay unchanged.
Fulfillment creates one usable ticket and one final order, with only the charge allowed by the prepared payment policy.
An initial card authorization is not mistaken for a completed ticket payment.
tests.scope_limit: Keep the final order/reference. Controlled replay, changed-request rejection and database failure injection belong to engineering/owning-team checks. Missing final background proof is Blocked.

tests.title: Connect a guest order to the matching Customer only
tests.why: Claim retries now wrap ticket ownership. The whole existing order must connect once, and a different email must still be rejected.
preparation: One completed, unclaimed guest order contains 2 tickets purchased with controlled Email A. Keep its confirmation link.
Have a matching Email A account and a different Email B account. Neither should own the order initially.
steps: Open the order confirmation and use Connect Purchase or its existing account-connection action. Try Email B first.
After the rejection, sign in with Email A and connect the same purchase once.
Refresh My Orders, open both tickets and reopen the order confirmation.
expectations: Email B cannot take the order or either ticket.
Email A sees the same single order and both correct tickets. No additional purchase, charge, email claim or partial ownership is created.
tests.scope_limit: Do not buy the tickets again. Retry exhaustion, recursive Membership effects and transaction rollback require controlled engineering evidence.

qase.basis_or_limit: Saved cases cover same-email claim success and different-email rejection. They do not inject the narrow database deadlock, retries, child failure or rollback.
